title: Scene 5 · T2 — Beth on Paula's Botox, then pulls out the stool: 'Come sit. Watch this.' (SH03–SH04)
line: Paula had Botox last month. Of course she looks like that. That's needles, two thousand dollars, and doing it all again in twelve weeks. / I'm not saying you go do that. You don't need to. Come sit. Watch this.
motionPlan: Beth lays the garment bag on the bed and talks while she does it ; Beth pulls the dressing-table stool out with one hand and nods Susan to it; Susan gets up from the bed and sits
note: Waits for the Scene 5 ingredient cards' Confirm, then one Seedance call.
